description: Font coverage: does this font have glyphs for this text, and does it fit the box — Reads a TrueType or OpenType font you supply as base64 (up to 2 MB) and a text of up to 5000 characters, for an agent about to render text in a fixed font: lists every code point with no glyph in the cmap (formats 4 and 12) and sums the hmtx advance widths to test a width in pixels. Every offset is bounds-checked. It does not apply kerning, ligatures or shaping (combining marks and complex scripts

fontBase64.description: Base64 of a .ttf or .otf file (sfnt, not WOFF).

maxWidthPx.description: Box width; the widest line (split on \n) must fit.

name: font-coverage
